question: Which of the following is the correct longitudinal extent of the Prime Meridian?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0°**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Meridian:** The Prime Meridian is the longitudinal line designated at **0° longitude**. It serves as the starting point for measuring longitude around the globe.
 
• It is also known as the Greenwich Meridian because it passes through the **Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London**.
 
• The Prime Meridian divides the Earth into two hemispheres: the **Eastern Hemisphere** and the **Western Hemisphere**. This makes it a significant reference point in geography.
 
• The longitudinal extent of the Prime Meridian is measured as **0°**, and it is used as the basis for the **Global Coordinate System.**
 
• The Prime Meridian is universally accepted as the reference for calculating **time zones**, with **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)** being based on this meridian.
 
• Other options mentioned in the question, such as **90° E, 180° E,** and **23.5° N**, refer to different coordinates on Earth. They do not represent the Prime Meridian, which is always 0° longitude. Hence, these options are incorrect.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 0°.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prime Meridian History:**

 
 
• The concept of the Prime Meridian was formalized during the **International Meridian Conference** in **1884** in Washington, D.C.
 
• It was decided that the meridian passing through the **Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London**, would be the global Prime Meridian.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Prime Meridian:**
 
 
• It serves as the reference line for measuring longitude, which ranges from **0° to 180°** east and west.
 
• The Prime Meridian is crucial in defining **time zones**. The time at the Prime Meridian is referred to as **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT).**
 
• It helps in determining the **International Date Line**, which is located at 180° longitude.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Greenwich:**
 
 
• Greenwich was chosen as the location for the Prime Meridian due to its historical importance in navigation and astronomy.
 
• The **Royal Observatory**, established in **1675** by King Charles II of England, played a pivotal role in advancing maritime navigation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Longitude and its Measurement:**

 
 
• **Longitude** is measured in degrees east or west of the Prime Meridian, ranging from **0°** at the Prime Meridian to **180°**.
 
• Longitude lines are used in conjunction with latitude lines to define **coordinates** for any location on Earth.
 
 
 
• **Other Meridians:**
 
 
• **90° E:** Refers to the longitude passing through eastern Asia, including parts of India and China.
 
• **180°:** Refers to the **International Date Line**, which serves as the opposite side of the Prime Meridian.
 
• **23.5° N:** Refers to the latitude of the **Tropic of Cancer**, not a longitude.
